arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Extract the FY 1945-1959 surplus/deficit values (in millions)
# From 1954 bulletin for 1945-1947 (not in 1960 bulletin)
# From 1960 bulletin for 1948-1959 (more complete/revised data)

values = [
    -53941,  # FY 1945 (from 1954 bulletin)
    -20676,  # FY 1946 (from 1954 bulletin)
    754,     # FY 1947 (from 1954 bulletin)
    8419,    # FY 1948 (from both bulletins)
    -1811,   # FY 1949 (from both bulletins)
    -3122,   # FY 1950 (from both bulletins)
    3510,    # FY 1951 (from both bulletins)
    -4017,   # FY 1952 (from both bulletins)
    -9449,   # FY 1953 (from 1960 bulletin - revised)
    -3117,   # FY 1954 (from both bulletins)
    -4180,   # FY 1955 (from 1960 bulletin)
    1626,    # FY 1956 (from 1960 bulletin)
    1596,    # FY 1957 (from 1960 bulletin)
    -2819,   # FY 1958 (from 1960 bulletin)
    -12427   # FY 1959 (from 1960 bulletin)
]

print("FY 1945-1959 surplus/deficit values (in millions):")
for i, v in enumerate(values):
    print(f"FY {1945+i}: {v}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean}")

# Calculate squared deviations
squared_deviations = [(x - mean) ** 2 for x in values]
sum_sq_dev = sum(squared_deviations)
print(f"Sum of squared deviations: {sum_sq_dev}")

# Sample variance (n-1 denominator)
sample_variance = sum_sq_dev / (n - 1)
print(f"Sample variance: {sample_variance}")

# Sample standard deviation
sample_std = math.sqrt(sample_variance)
print(f"Sample standard deviation: {sample_std}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest thousandths: {sample_std:.3f}")
EOF
